title: Transportation, Erection of trestle Tower & Construction of Service room for Trestle Tower at Valiyakara Lighthouse site.
summary: E-tender for transporting and erecting a trestle tower and building a service room at the Valiyakara Lighthouse site on Valiyakara Island, Lakshadweep.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

sites.name: Valiyakara Lighthouse site, Valiyakara Island, UT of Lakshadweep
sites.work: Transportation and erection of trestle tower; construction of service room

scope.item: Transportation and erection of trestle tower
Construction of service room for trestle tower

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME certificate) with technical documents by 14.11.2023 15:00. Bid Securing Declaration (Annexure VI) also listed.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies; OR, for contractors from Lakshadweep, work experience with any Government department during last 07 years in island works
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%
Tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV), unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure V), Bid Securing Declaration (Annexure VI)
List of relatives serving in Ministry of Shipping or DGLL (Annexure VII); non-blacklisting affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper (Annexure VIII)
Annual turnover of last three years certified by CA
notes: Section I NIT only; no BOQ or tower specification. Listing title calls it 'NIQ' and spells 'Valiakara', but document is a Notice Inviting e-Tender. OCR text layer garbled EMD and opening date; pages 1-2 read from rendered images. Bid download/submission 20.10.2023 10:00 to 15.11.2023 15:00; bid query last date 01.11.2023.
